chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ṣafwān and Faḍālah, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two عليهم السلام, who said:
I asked him about forgetfulness in Salat al-Maghrib, so he said: He repeats it until he retains it correctly, for it is not like the even-numbered prayer.

key_terms.السَّهْوِ: forgetfulness or inadvertent uncertainty occurring during prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib prayer, the sunset salat consisting of three rakʿahs
key_terms.يَحْفَظَ: he becomes certain and retains the prayer correctly

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on forgetfulness in Salat al-Maghrib according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning forgetfulness in Salat al-Maghrib. It states that if one experiences sahw in the Maghrib prayer, he should repeat the prayer until he is certain of it, because Maghrib does not have the same ruling as an even-numbered prayer.
